tagline: Leading digital and technology solutions for the energy industry
hero_kpi_rationale: Digital revenue is a key segment for SLB, representing $2.7 billion in 2025 with 9% growth, driven by strong adoption of Digital Operations and Platforms Applications amid the energy transition.

kpis.name: Digital Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by SLB's digital business division
kpis.description: SLB's digital revenue reached $2.7 billion in 2025, growing 9% year-over-year driven by strong uptake in Digital Operations and Platforms Applications

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: SLB's gross margin improved to 28.0% in 2025, up 291 basis points year-over-year, driven by higher revenue and operational efficiency gains

kpis.name: Data Center Solutions Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of Data Center Solutions revenue
kpis.description: SLB's Data Center Solutions revenue grew 121% year-over-year in 2025, driven by expansion of modular data center manufacturing capabilities and partnerships with hyperscalers

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash flow generated from operating activities
kpis.description: SLB generated $6.5 billion of operating cash flow in 2025, declining 10% year-over-year due to lower upstream spending in key markets

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free cash flow available to all investors after capital expenditures
kpis.description: SLB generated $4.1 billion of free cash flow in 2025, declining 15% year-over-year due to lower operating cash flow and capital deployment

kpis.name: Shareholder Returns
kpis.explanation: Total cash returned to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases
kpis.description: SLB returned $4.0 billion to shareholders in 2025, up 11% year-over-year, demonstrating commitment to investor returns despite challenging market conditions

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented a challenging backdrop with lower commodity prices that reduced upstream spending and impacted global revenue, declining 2% year-on-year despite strong digital growth (MD&A, Item 7)

risks.title: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: 2025 presented challenging backdrop with geopolitical uncertainty affecting operations, particularly impacting international revenue which declined 5% year-on-year, notably in Saudi Arabia, Mexico and Sub-Saharan Africa (MD&A, Item 7)

risks.title: Market competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Oversupplied oil market and competitive dynamics in oilfield services sector pressure pricing and market share (MD&A, Item 7)

risks.title: Technology and digital transformation execution
risks.score_rationale: SLB's growth strategy depends on successful deployment and adoption of AI and digital solutions; execution risks exist in developing and commercializing these technologies at scale

risks.title: Integration of ChampionX acquisition
risks.score_rationale: SLB completed $4.9 billion ChampionX acquisition in Q3 2025; integration risks exist including operational consolidation, cultural alignment, and achieving synergy targets (MD&A, Item 7)

risks.title: Liquidity and debt management
risks.score_rationale: SLB carries $9.7 billion long-term debt and $1.9 billion short-term borrowings as of December 31, 2025, requiring disciplined capital allocation (Balance Sheet, Item 8)

risks.title: Upstream spending cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: 2025 saw amidst lower upstream spending a 2% revenue decline; international revenue declined 5% due to lower activity in key regions (MD&A, Item 7)

ai_positioning.summary: SLB integrates AI into its operations and solution portfolios, particularly through its Digital Operations and Platforms Applications segments. The company uses AI to optimize client solutions and is accelerating the deployment of AI-based offerings, especially in its digital services and data center solutions.
evidence: MD&A: 'increased deployment of AI solutions and the rapid expansion of our Data Center Solutions business' (2025 Executive Overview)
MD&A: 'Digital revenue increased 9% driven by significant uptake in Digital Operations as well as steady growth in Platforms Applications' (Full-Year 2025 Results)
MD&A: Data Center Solutions serving hyperscalers with modular manufacturing capabilities, indicating AI infrastructure support
